# Goal Tracker

> Free, open-source, offline-first habit and goal tracker for Android and iOS.
> Built with Expo SDK 58, React Native 0.88, TypeScript, and SQLite.
> No account, no cloud, no ads, no analytics.

Goal Tracker is a local-first mobile app for building consistent routines. You
create a tracker for something you want to improve, add check-based or numeric
goals with daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly targets, and log progress from the
Today screen. Streaks and statistics show how consistently you follow through.
All data stays in a local SQLite database on the device.

## Key facts

- License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0)
- Price: free; no ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases
- Platforms: Android (APK releases), iOS (build from source)
- Accounts: none
- Network: not required for core features
- Data storage: on-device SQLite (`goaltracker.db`)
- Languages: English UI
- Latest release: https://github.com/toprakpt1/goal-tracker/releases/latest

## Features

- Trackers with name, unit, icon, color, and quick-add step
- Checklist goals and numeric goals
- Daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly targets
- Multiple goals per tracker sharing one log stream
- Scheduled goals limited to a specific day, week, month, or year
- Current and best streaks, completed periods, tracked goals
- Optional daily reminders via local notifications
- Notes on goals and log entries
- Light, dark, and system themes; configurable week start; haptics
- Offline-first SQLite storage with versioned migrations

## Repository layout

- `src/app` — Expo Router screens and layouts
- `src/components` — reusable mobile UI components
- `src/db` — SQLite schema, migrations, queries, repositories
- `src/domain` — periods, progress, scopes, streak calculations
- `src/hooks` — data and settings hooks
- `src/i18n` — user-facing strings
- `src/lib` — notifications, formatting, icons, utilities
- `src/store` — local application state
- `src/theme` — colors, typography, spacing, theme helpers

## Development

- Install: `npm install`
- Start: `npx expo start`
- Test: `npm test`
- Lint: `npm run lint`
- Typecheck: `npm run typecheck`
